decision: OBJECT - 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 1 SHOULD-FIX. The subject was unmoved at the required path, SHA-256 b68debe3baf1420b5e9311a7582101ef1d68eb505f9bb0c5b41e3f916809fd91, and mode 0444. Every cited digest reproduced against the live tree. The no-cell-edit branch excludes D-236. The live register state, the Stage A verdicts, the Codex observation shape, the landing claim, and every scope denial in the doesNot litany verified true. The single surviving finding is that the Measured inputs table and the remasurement clause both drop corpus v1 and corpus v2, while the Decision limb continues to assert authoring-staleness for NT-1/NT-2 implementations and for per-D-002-platform copies of those implementations - claims that rest on exactly those two artifacts - and continues to promise 'Does not rewrite corpus v1, corpus v2, or corpus v7'. Both directly comparable adopted precedents (D-244, the preceding leftover-join remasurement, and D-245, the immediately preceding entry) pinned corpus v1 and corpus v2 in Measured inputs, and D-245 additionally named them in its remasurement unmoved set. Nothing asserted is false and the two digests remain transitively recoverable from the pinned v11 recordedInputs map, which is why this is SHOULD-FIX and not MUST-FIX.

shouldFixFindings.title: Measured inputs and the remasurement clause drop corpus v1 and corpus v2, while the Decision limb still asserts authoring-staleness claims that rest on them and still promises not to rewrite them
where: Decision paragraph 2, the leftover-design decomposition (subject lines 143-149) and the rewrite denial (subject lines 175-176)
shouldFixFindings.claimUnderReview: The subject asserts in its own Decision voice that 'leftover-design of NT-1 and NT-2 implementations, and of per-D-002-platform copies of those implementations, is stale as an authoring claim' (lines 145-147, restated at lines 123-126), and separately promises 'Does not rewrite corpus v1, corpus v2, or corpus v7' (lines 45 and 175-176). The Measured inputs table pins corpus v7 (20bf75a4b404f54d16b531659af825ef6f86d3721ea10cb3c0c435b0e496c57f) and occupancy v4, and pins the whole leftover-join lineage v4 through v10, but pins neither corpus v1 nor corpus v2. The remasurement clause enumerates its unmoved set as 'file 08, leftover-join v11, both Stage A verdicts, leftover-join v4 through v10, occupancy v4, corpus v7, and this draft' - corpus v1 and corpus v2 appear in neither surface.
shouldFixFindings.whatIsTrue: The staleness of the NT-1/NT-2 authoring claim is established by g21-fixture-corpus.v1.json (D-241) and the staleness of the per-D-002-platform-copies claim by g21-fixture-corpus.v2.json (D-243). Both files are live and unmoved: corpus v1 is 861bb4e7d26a80158cc1cc3a0518c5e8e95311bee4d8c8ce63acd1e60d6c906d and corpus v2 is af24c6e7294c5802e02063ad0875907b68e264581f6521325dc6d6b60a97fba1. The subject's recitation is therefore true today. The gap is custodial, not factual: the two artifacts that make two of the subject's three staleness assertions true are outside both the pinned set and the drift guard.
shouldFixFindings.precedent: D-244, the immediately preceding entry of the same document class (leftover-join remasurement, recording v9), pinned 'Frozen corpus v2 (D-243; not this subject)' af24c6e7294c5802e02063ad0875907b68e264581f6521325dc6d6b60a97fba1 and 'Frozen corpus v1 (D-241; not this subject)' 861bb4e7d26a80158cc1cc3a0518c5e8e95311bee4d8c8ce63acd1e60d6c906d in its Measured inputs table, while carrying the same 'Does not rewrite corpus v1 or corpus v2' denial. D-245, the immediately preceding adopted entry, pinned both in Measured inputs AND named both in its remasurement unmoved set ('with file 08, leftover-join v9, occupancy v4, corpus v1, corpus v2, corpus v3 through v6, corpus v7, both Stage A verdicts, ... unmoved'). D-245 reached that text at turn 2 after an adversarial turn 1 that landed D245-M1 and CODEX-D245-SF1, so the pinning is settled, reviewed convention rather than incidental.
shouldFixFindings.whyThisIsNotMerelyEditorial: The remasurement clause is the operative drift guard between draft freeze and adoption. As written, corpus v1 or corpus v2 could move before adoption without triggering remasurement, and two load-bearing sentences in the Decision limb would silently lose their support while the entry still promised not to rewrite those same files. D-245 guarded exactly this and D-246 does not. The asymmetry is also internal: the subject pins every artifact in the leftover-join lineage it is recording (v4 through v10) and pins the newest corpus authoring event (v7), but omits the two older corpus authoring events whose bytes it affirmatively relies on.
shouldFixFindings.whyNotMustFix: No recited claim is false, and verifiability is preserved by three independent routes: the corpus v1 and corpus v2 digests both appear in the 59-entry recordedInputs map inside g21-leftover-join.v11.json, which IS pinned at ea8d2c52723a46eef3388b93e2a529a5af999d24363a695719d6d7a1bd08224f; both Stage A reviewers audited that recorded-input set; and D-241 and D-243 are adopted entries inside COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md, which is pinned at fd74c2f464771f814705b20443cef3e0ba4a797c82cf00b629cc705b99c286b4. The defect is a weakened drift guard and a precedent regression, not an unsupported recording.
shouldFixFindings.narrowestRepair: Add two rows to the Measured inputs table - 'Frozen corpus v2 (D-243; not this subject)' af24c6e7294c5802e02063ad0875907b68e264581f6521325dc6d6b60a97fba1 and 'Frozen corpus v1 (D-241; not this subject)' 861bb4e7d26a80158cc1cc3a0518c5e8e95311bee4d8c8ce63acd1e60d6c906d - and name corpus v1 and corpus v2 in the remasurement clause's unmoved set. No other limb changes. This adds no identifier, no platform list, no obligation, and no register effect.
shouldFixFindings.whatThisFindingDoesNotAsk: It does not ask for corpus v3 through v6 to be pinned; the subject makes no affirmative claim resting on them beyond denying them current standing, and the leftover-join lineage it records is fully pinned. It does not ask for any change to the leftoverDesign recitation, the landing claim, the branch enumeration, or any doesNot line. It does not ask to mark any row SATISFIED, to close leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING, or to alter required-now 28.
